line_text: What is it?

line_text: The jungle denies us our passage. / What have we done? / We? No. I.

line_text: Making an appearance? / I am. / I thought you'd left for good.

speaker: Fran
line_text: Our choices are few.

speaker: Fran
line_text: This is as much for you as it is me.

speaker: Fran
line_text: You are ill at ease. / The nethicite troubles you?

line_text: You've let your eyes betray your heart.
Right.

line_text: What are you doing?

speaker: Fran
line_text: Soon you will learn.

line_text: We go to seek aid of the viera who dwell ahead.

line_text: I am unwelcome. An unsought guest in their wood.
